arabic text: AKBAR MAIN MAR JAWAN GI, VATNA TE VEER AAJA
english translation text: AKBAR, I WILL DIE — O BROTHER, RETURN TO YOUR HOMELAND.

arabic text: VEER NA MENU KHUWAB DARONDAY NAE, BHEN DAE DARD MUKHA JA
english translation text: BROTHER, DO NOT FRIGHTEN ME IN DREAMS — COME AND END YOUR SISTER’S PAIN.

arabic text: AEHO RASTAY AEHO BOOHAY, AEHO MITTIAAN AKBAR
english translation text: THE SAME PATHS, THE SAME DOORS, THE SAME SOIL, O AKBAR.

arabic text: AEHO TAANGAN AEHO ASAAN, AEHO CHITTIYAAN AKBAR
english translation text: THE SAME COURTYARDS, THE SAME WALLS, THE SAME WHITEWASHED HOMES, O AKBAR.

arabic text: WEKH LEY ASI BHEN BHIRA SAANJHAY, SAADA DARD WI SAANJHA
english translation text: SEE, WE ARE SIBLINGS WHO SHARE — EVEN OUR PAIN IS SHARED.

arabic text: KOI HOUNDA MERA APNA, MERAY ATHRU WAND'DA
english translation text: IF ONLY THERE WAS SOMEONE OF MINE TO SHARE MY TEARS,

arabic text: AKAY SIR TE MERAY KOI, KADI SAYA KARDA
english translation text: IF ONLY SOMEONE WOULD PLACE A SHADE OVER MY HEAD,

arabic text: KAKH TOUN MENU AAKHAY UTHANDA JEY, KEHNDA TAKHT TEY AAJA
english translation text: IF ONLY SOMEONE WOULD LIFT ME FROM THE GROUND, SAYING, 'COME, SIT ON THE THRONE.'

arabic text: MEINU KHWABAN DARAYA, EY BARRA VEER AKBAR
english translation text: MY ELDER BROTHER AKBAR, YOUR DREAMS HAVE FRIGHTENED ME.

arabic text: VAIKHAY AIY MAAWAN NU BAZAARAN’CH MEI BIN CHADAR
english translation text: YOU HAVE SEEN YOUR MOTHERS IN THE MARKETPLACES WITHOUT A VEIL.

arabic text: VEERNA MEINU AAKE IK WAARI, KHAYR DI KHABR SUNAAJAA
english translation text: BROTHER, COME ONCE AND BRING ME GOOD NEWS.

arabic text: MEINU ASGHAR TE SAKINA BARRA YAAD AANDAY NAY
english translation text: I REMEMBER ASGHAR AND SAKINA VERY MUCH.

arabic text: KHAALI VAIRAY’CH DOWEN BEIT MEINU DISDE NAY
english translation text: IN THE EMPTY COURTYARD, I SEE THEM BOTH SITTING.

arabic text: DOVAN NU SANG APNE LEYA KE TU, MERE NAAL MILAA JAA
english translation text: BRING BOTH OF THEM WITH YOU, AND REUNITE THEM WITH ME.

arabic text: JAANDI HONDI JEY AKBAR, TU NAI MURKE AUNA
english translation text: IF I HAD KNOWN, AKBAR, THAT YOU WOULD NEVER RETURN,

arabic text: ES GAL TE VEER MAHMAL, TUSSI MEINU LAANA
english translation text: THEN, O BROTHER, YOU SHOULD HAVE BROUGHT ME IN YOUR LITTER.

arabic text: JAANDEYA TU AAP BAQAYYE VICH, BEHN DI QABR BANAA JAA
english translation text: AS YOU DEPARTED, YOU SHOULD HAVE BUILT YOUR SISTER’S GRAVE.

arabic text: MEREY DADAY KOLON JEEWEN, PUPHI ZAINAB PUCHIYAA
english translation text: JUST AS MY GRANDFATHER WAS ASKED, SO TOO WAS AUNT ZAINAB ASKED,

arabic text: BHEER BAZARAN DA MEINU, BABA MATLAB DAS JA
english translation text: 'O FATHER, EXPLAIN TO ME THE MEANING OF THESE CROWDED MARKETPLACES.'

arabic text: IS TARHA MEINU PEYR NISHAANAN DA, MATLAB TU SAMJHA JA
english translation text: IN THE SAME WAY, EXPLAIN TO ME THE MEANING OF THESE FOOTPRINTS.

arabic text: ROZ AKBAR SEYN SUGHRA, AEHO BHARDI HAAWAAN
english translation text: EVERY DAY SUGHRA LAMENTS, 'O AKBAR…'

arabic text: AAS REH GAI VEER AKBAR, KINNU MEHNDI LAAWAAN
english translation text: 'BROTHER AKBAR, WHO IS LEFT FOR ME TO APPLY HENNA UPON?'

arabic text: AEY DASSA KINNU VEER KAWEY SUGHRA, AAN KEY SEHREY LAA JA
english translation text: 'TELL ME, BROTHER, WHOM SHALL SUGHRA CALL TO PLACE THE WEDDING TURBAN?'
